memory.notes: Fill in cache sizes and memory bandwidth for the target node.

tune_hints: Prefer contiguous memory access and unit-stride inner loops.
Check compiler vectorization reports before forcing intrinsics.
Benchmark with representative problem sizes and pinned CPU frequency.

memory.notes: Bandwidth-sensitive kernels should be checked for NUMA placement and first-touch initialization.

tune_hints: Use AVX-512-aware compiler flags on nodes where frequency behavior is acceptable.
Validate OpenMP thread affinity and NUMA first-touch behavior.
Tile memory-bound stencils to improve cache reuse.

memory.notes: AMX helps dense matrix kernels when libraries and data types are aligned with the target.

tune_hints: Use oneAPI reports for vectorization, threading, and memory diagnostics.
Consider AMX-enabled math libraries for dense low-precision matrix kernels.
Tune OpenMP affinity with compact/scatter policies and measure both.

memory.notes: Use Nsight Compute metrics to classify memory-bound versus compute-bound kernels.

tune_hints: Batch host-device transfers and avoid small synchronous copies.
Check occupancy, memory coalescing, shared-memory bank conflicts, and tensor-core eligibility.
Use CUDA graphs for repeated launch patterns when launch overhead is visible.

memory.notes: Unified-memory behavior should be profiled carefully for placement and bandwidth.

tune_hints: Use ROCm profiling to separate kernel time, transfer time, and memory-placement effects.
Prefer large, coalesced GPU kernels and avoid excessive CPU-GPU synchronization.
Validate HIP portability separately from CUDA-oriented assumptions.
